:::{layout-ncol=3}

### data.table

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(data.table)
dt <- mtcars
data.table::setDT(dt)
```
:::


### dplyr 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(magrittr)
df <- mtcars
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
baseR <- aggregate(. ~ cyl, data = df, FUN = length)
baseR <- baseR[c("cyl", "mpg")]  # Adjust column names if needed
print(baseR)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  cyl mpg
1   4  11
2   6   7
3   8  14
```


:::
:::


:::

### group by


:::{layout-ncol=2}



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dt[, .(n=.N), by= .(cyl)]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     cyl     n
   <num> <int>
1:     6     7
2:     4    11
3:     8    14
```


:::
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df %>% group_by(cyl) %>% 
  summarize(n=n())
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 3 × 2
    cyl     n
  <dbl> <int>
1     4    11
2     6     7
3     8    14
```


:::
:::


:::


::: {layout-ncol=2}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dt[, .(avg= mean(mpg)), by= .(cyl)]
```

```

   <num> <num>
1:     6 19.74
2:     4 26.66
3:     8 15.10
```


:::
:::


# pivot

- [link](https://www.statology.org/pivot_longer-in-r/)

::: {layout-ncol=2}



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# wide dataframe
wide_dt <- data.frame(player=c('A', 'B', 'C', 'D'),
                 year1=c(12, 15, 19, 19),
                 year2=c(22, 29, 18, 12))
data.table::setDT(wide_dt)
head(wide_dt)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
   player year1 year2
   <char> <num> <num>
1:      A    12    22
2:      B    15    29
3:      C    19    18
4:      D    19    12
```


:::
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wide_df <- data.frame(player=c('A', 'B', 'C', 'D'),
                 year1=c(12, 15, 19, 19),
                 year2=c(22, 29, 18, 12))
wide_df
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  player year1 year2
1      A    12    22
2      B    15    29
3      C    19    18
4      D    19    12
```


:::
:::


:::

::: {layout-ncol=2}



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# wide dataframe to long dataframe
wide_to_long <- data.table::melt(wide_dt,
                                 measure.vars=c('year1','year2'),
                                 variable.name= 'year',
                                 value.name = 'points')
wide_to_long
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
   player   year points
   <char> <fctr>  <num>
1:      A  year1     12
2:      B  year1     15
3:      C  year1     19
4:      D  year1     19
5:      A  year2     22
6:      B  year2     29
7:      C  year2     18
8:      D  year2     12
```


:::
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
long_df <- tidyr::pivot_longer(wide_df,
                    cols=c('year1', 'year2'),
                    names_to='year',
                    values_to='points')

long_df
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 8 × 3
  player year  points
  <chr>  <chr>  <dbl>
1 A      year1     12
2 A      year2     22
3 B      year1     15
4 B      year2     29
5 C      year1     19
6 C      year2     18
7 D      year1     19
8 D      year2     12
```


:::
:::


:::

::: {layout-ncol=2}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# long dataframe to wide dataframe
long_to_wide <- data.table::dcast(wide_to_long, 
                                  player ~ year,
                                  value.var = 'points')
long_to_wide
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
Key: <player>
   player year1 year2
   <char> <num> <num>
1:      A    12    22
2:      B    15    29
3:      C    19    18
4:      D    19    12
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
long_to_wide_df <- tidyr::pivot_wider(long_df,
                              names_from = 'year',
                              values_from = 'points')
long_to_wide_df
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 4 × 3
  player year1 year2
  <chr>  <dbl> <dbl>
1 A         12    22
2 B         15    29
3 C         19    18
4 D         19    12
```


:::
:::


:::

#### pivot in base R with reshape()
##### long to wide
::: {layout-ncol=2}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# base R, reshape function
base_wide <- data.frame(player=c('A', 'B', 'C', 'D'),
                 year1=c(12, 15, 19, 19),
                 year2=c(22, 29, 18, 12))
base_wide
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  player year1 year2
1      A    12    22
2      B    15    29
3      C    19    18
4      D    19    12
```


:::
:::





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# wide to long
long_df <- reshape(
  base_wide,
  direction = "long",
  varying = list(c("year1", "year2")),
  v.names = "points",
  idvar = "player",
  times = c("year1", "year2"),
  timevar = "year"
)
long_df
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
        player  year points
A.year1      A year1     12
B.year1      B year1     15
C.year1      C year1     19
D.year1      D year1     19
A.year2      A year2     22
B.year2      B year2     29
C.year2      C year2     18
D.year2      D year2     12
```


:::
:::


:::

#### long to wide
::: {layout-ncol=2}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# long data
head(wide_to_long)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
   player   year points
   <char> <fctr>  <num>
1:      A  year1     12
2:      B  year1     15
3:      C  year1     19
4:      D  year1     19
5:      A  year2     22
6:      B  year2     29
```


:::
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# from long to wide
reshape(wide_to_long, direction = 'wide',idvar = 'player',
        timevar = 'year', v.names = 'points', sep = '_')
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
   player points_year1 points_year2
   <char>        <num>        <num>
1:      A           12           22
2:      B           15           29
3:      C           19           18
4:      D           19           12
```

### Join 

::: {layout-ncol=2}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

                X1  = c(1L, 3L, 5L, 7L),
                XY  = c("x2", "x4", "x6", "x8"),
                key = "Id")
x
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
Key: <Id>
       Id    X1     XY
   <char> <int> <char>
1:      A     1     x2
2:      B     3     x4
3:      C     5     x6
4:      C     7     x8
```

:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

                Y1  = c(1L, 3L, 5L, 7L),
```
